global_closure_blocker.description: Registry of specific mathematical features that block global closure claims.

blockers.impact: Irreducible; blocks all unique global preimage claims.
Singular boundary; blocks exact zero-limit formalization.
Core dynamic; blocks unique selection as a formal property.
Asymptotic; blocks global stability proof without axioms.

global_closure_blocker.governance_rule: The presence of these blockers prevents any target from achieving formalized_global status.
